authorization: Standing autonomous modelling approval; log decisions and preserve scientific limitations for later review.
sector_boundary_evidence: Inspected linked native sources distinguish Electricity/Heat at CHP power plant and Electricity at power plant from standalone Heat at heat plant and inverter manufacturing. The shipped ecoinvent GAINS precedence assigns conventional natural-gas CHP to Power_Gen_NatGas. Gas burned directly in manufacturing follows End_Use_Industry_NatGas.
limitations: Initial native natural-gas combustion planning only; other fuels, direct emissions, prepared CLIC/helpers and unreviewed callers are not updated by this component. This is not a complete emissions-sector update.

The emitting burner retains its original geography, complete fuel/infrastructure inventory and allocation. The caller function determines the GAINS sector: electricity and allocated CHP outputs use power generation; standalone heat and direct inverter-manufacturing combustion use industrial natural gas. The four RER inverter records retain the German burner geography; no relocation or new heat credit.

Apply only reviewed gaseous air reductions relative to the exact2020GAINSbase, preserving signed amounts and supported uncertainty. Water/soil, CO2, particulates, aggregate VOC and unreviewed species remain unchanged. Missing observations, zero baselines, zero targets and increases remain explicit dispositions rather than invented unity factors. Upstream technology/vintage/allocation and unquantified score limitations remain.
